name: @pipeworx/mcp-wger

tools.name: list_exercises
tools.description: List fitness exercises from the wger database in English; optionally limit count (default 20). Returns exercise name, description, category, primary and secondary muscles, and required equipment per entry.

limit.description: Number of exercises to return. Defaults to 20.

tools.name: get_exercise
tools.description: Get detailed information for a specific exercise by its numeric ID.

tools.name: list_muscles
tools.description: List all muscles tracked in the wger database. Returns each muscle's numeric ID, English name, and whether it is located on the front of the body.

tools.name: list_equipment
tools.description: List all gym equipment types in the wger database. Returns each item's numeric ID and name (e.g., 'Barbell', 'Dumbbell', 'Kettlebell').

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-wger forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the wger pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
